presentations.more: `getAnnotation` is documented to answer nothing in ordinary conditions — an unset variable, the end of a stream, a path that is not there — and the type this function sees does not say so, so the compiler lets it dereference the answer unchecked. When the answer is absent, the first member access throws. Test the answer, or supply a default, before using it.
